input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，this phrase is redundant because both parts refer to time. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，this refers to a concrete group of people in ancient times, so the plural noun is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，here the mother perceives the result or effect, so use the resultative form meaning “see/noticed,” rather than the process verb meaning “look.” [rule: resultative_complement]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他很小的时候，Mencius is first introduced in this scene, so introduce him with both his identity and name before using the name alone. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：他的同学们老是对他开玩笑，this is a repeated habit signaled by “老是,” so it takes the zero particle rather than completed-action “了.” [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：因为他每天只祭拜，所以没有朋友，this is a cause-and-effect relation, which needs the connector pair “因为……所以……”; “虽然” introduces contrast instead. [rule: none]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly phrased under the teacher's rule.
人 is too generic here for the concrete group of people in ancient times; 人们 is required.
The mother notices an effect, so 看到 is needed rather than the process verb 看.
孟子 is first introduced here, so he should be introduced before the narrative switches to 他.
老是 marks a habitual action, so the sentence should not use completed-action 了; however, the shown correction still leaves 对他开玩笑 instead of the teacher's 跟他开玩笑.
This is a cause-and-effect relation, so 因为……所以…… is a correct replacement for the mismatched 虽然……因为…… structure.
